claimAssessments.claim: たくさん expresses a large quantity and may be used adverbially or before の + a noun.

claimAssessments.rationale: The dictionary labels it a noun/adjectival noun, allows adverbial use, and gives 本をたくさん持っている and たくさんの贈り物.
